title: 第516章 大侄子快点出去吧第515章 娜娜娜娜
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
空气像是凝固了。
那一声娜娜，比任何军令都更有分量，在场的每一个德玛西亚军官都听得清清楚楚。
所有人的动作都停了下来，呼吸都放轻了，目光在肖恩、缇亚娜和盖伦之间来回打转。
眼前这个人是谁？
德玛西亚的兵马大元帅，冕卫家族的掌舵人，帝国一人之下万人之上的存在。
而这个看起来年轻得过分的少年，竟然敢用这种亲昵到近乎狎昵的称呼喊她。
要么，是他嫌命太长了。
要么，就是私底下，她们的关系已经到了某种外人无法想象的地步。
缇亚娜低着头，金色的发丝垂下，遮住了她的脸，让人看不清她此刻的神情。
但她放在身侧的手，已经握成了拳头。
银翼城的城主，一个久经沙场的老将，此刻额头上已经渗出了细密的汗珠。
他第一个反应过来，干咳了一声，打破了这令人窒息的寂静。
“元帅大人，那个……城防事务还有些紧急安排，我……我先失陪一下。”
他对着缇亚娜的方向深深鞠了一躬，然后像是躲避瘟疫一样，转身快步离开，脚步急促得几乎要小跑起来。
有他带头，其他的军官们也如梦初醒。
“对对对，元帅，我突然想起巡逻队那边还有个漏洞需要我去补上。”
“我的副官刚才好像有急事找我，我也先告退了。”
“元帅大人您和贵客先聊，我们不打扰了。”
转眼之间，议事厅跟过来的军官们便找着各种蹩脚的理由，一窝蜂地退了出去，走廊里传来一阵杂乱远去的脚步声。
他们不敢再听下去，冕卫家族的八卦，听多了是会要命的。

很快，原本还算热闹的客房门口，就只剩下了三个人。
还有一扇被踹烂的门板，孤零零地躺在地上。
盖伦还傻傻地站在原地，他高大的身躯因为愤怒而微微颤抖，英俊的脸庞涨得通红。
“你……叫我姑姑什么……”他咬着牙，一字一句地从牙缝里挤出这句话。
这个称呼，对冕卫家族而言，对姑姑这位家族的掌舵人来说，不仅仅是冒犯，更是一种侮辱。
“你再叫一遍！”盖伦的右手已经再次握住了剑柄，手背上青筋暴起。
肖恩闻言，甚至懒得看他，目光依旧落在缇亚娜身上。
他慢悠悠地抬起手，用小指抠了抠鼻子，然后才开口。
“娜娜。”
盖伦的眼睛瞬间红了。
“娜娜。”
肖恩又叫了一声。
“娜娜。”
第三声。
每喊一次，盖伦脸上的血色就褪去一分，取而代之的是一种近乎狰狞的怒火。
而缇亚娜的身体，也随着这三声呼唤，变得越来越僵硬。
“我杀了你！”
盖伦终于忍不住了，他发出一声怒吼，腰间的符文大剑带着破风声猛然出鞘，化作一道银光，直直地朝着肖恩的头顶劈了过来！
content_en:
The air seemed to be frozen.
That sound of Nana was more weighty than any military order, and every Demacian officer present could hear it clearly.
Everyone stopped moving, breathing softly, and looked back and forth between Sean, Tiana, and Galen.
Who is this person in front of me?
The Grand Marshal of Demacia, the helmsman of the Crownguard family, and the most powerful person in the empire.
And this boy who looked too young actually dared to call her such an intimate and almost affectionate name.
Or maybe he thinks his life is too long.
Or, privately, their relationship has reached a level that outsiders cannot imagine.
Tiana lowered her head, her golden hair hanging down, covering her face, making it difficult for people to see her expression clearly.
But the hand she placed on her side was already clenched into a fist.
The lord of Silver Wing City, a veteran who has been on the battlefield for many years, had beads of sweat on his forehead at this moment.
He was the first to react and broke the suffocating silence with a dry cough.
"Marshal, um... there are some urgent arrangements for city defense matters. I... I'll excuse you for a moment."
He bowed deeply in Tiana's direction, and then, as if avoiding the plague, turned around and left quickly, his steps so fast that he almost started to trot.
With him taking the lead, the other officers also woke up from their dreams.
"Yes, yes, Marshal, I suddenly remembered that there is a loophole in the patrol team that I need to fill."
"My adjutant seemed to have come to see me in an emergency just now, so I will take my leave first."
"Master Marshal, please chat with your distinguished guest first, we won't interrupt you."
In the blink of an eye, the officers who had followed them from the meeting room found various lame excuses and swarmed out, and there was a chaotic sound of distant footsteps in the corridor.
They didn't dare to listen anymore. Listening to too much gossip about the Crownguard family would be fatal.
Soon, only three people were left at the door of the originally lively guest room.
There was also a kicked-in door panel, lying alone on the ground.
Galen was still standing there stupidly, his tall body trembling slightly with anger, and his handsome face flushed red.
"You... why did you call me aunt..." He gritted his teeth and squeezed out the words word by word from his teeth.
This title is not only offensive to the Crownguard family, but also an insult to the aunt, the head of the family.
"Scream again!" Galen's right hand had already grasped the hilt of the sword again, and veins popped out on the back of his hand.
When Sean heard this, he didn't even bother to look at him, his eyes still fell on Tiana.
He slowly raised his hand and picked his nose with his little finger before speaking.
"Nana."
Galen's eyes instantly turned red.
"Nana."
Sean yelled again.
"Nana."
The third sound.
Every time he shouted, the color on Galen's face faded a bit, replaced by an almost ferocious anger.
And Tiana's body became stiffer and stiffer with these three calls.
"I'll kill you!"
Galen finally couldn't bear it anymore. He let out a roar, and the rune sword on his waist suddenly unsheathed with a sound of breaking wind, turned into a ray of silver light, and struck straight towards Sean's head!
